questions.q: What does the Sales Director report?
options: The Territory page's headline card and detail table show different Total Sales for the same filtered territory
The report fails to load entirely
The segment page shows a negative total
The scheduled refresh stopped working
questions.explain: The symptom is a mismatch between two numbers on the same page, same filter, not a refresh or load failure.

questions.q: What is the first job once a discrepancy is reported?
options: Reproduce the problem reliably on your own screen before touching any measure
Immediately rewrite the suspect measure
Delete the headline card
Assume the Sales Director made an error and ignore the report
questions.explain: Confirming the report is real, with concrete numbers, comes before any fix.

questions.q: What is the single most useful diagnostic habit described for isolating the cause?
options: Change one thing (the territory filter) at a time and watch what does and doesn't change
Rewrite every measure in the model simultaneously
Compare the model to the Beginner project's model
Re-run the T-SQL extract from scratch
questions.explain: Isolating the variable -- changing only the territory -- reveals which visual responds correctly and which doesn't.

questions.q: What specific pattern is the real tell?
options: The detail table's Total Sales changes correctly per territory, but the headline card never changes regardless of which territory is selected
Both numbers change together but by different amounts
Both numbers stay exactly zero
The detail table shows an error message
questions.explain: A card that never responds to its supposed filter is the specific signal that something is ignoring that filter entirely.

questions.q: What should you NOT do yet, according to this lesson?
options: Rewrite or delete any measure, or guess which number is 'probably' wrong
Reproduce the comparison for a second territory
Record both numbers for multiple territories
Recall what Lesson 9 said about the benchmark measures
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly defers any fix until Lesson 14 confirms the actual cause.
